sources.dataset: Forebears — country-specific Most Common Last Names (2014 estimates)
sources.geographical_scope: Democratic Republic of the Congo (CD/COD); not Republic of the Congo (CG/COG)
sources.coverage: 1001 source rows; 1001 unique NFC Latin-script surnames retained after punctuation/diacritic equivalence checks. Research-only partial pool (target 3000).
sources.limitations: Country-specific DR Congo ranking; incidence estimates are not civil-registration counts. The source has 1001 records because last rank 1000 is tied. Estimated national surname incidence only; individual legal-register attestation and source redistribution rights are not independently established. Source ranks and frequencies never used for sampling.

sources.dataset: ProceduralTextGeneration — source-order transcription of country-specific Forebears surname table
sources.geographical_scope: Democratic Republic of the Congo (CD/COD); not Republic of the Congo (CG/COG)
sources.temporal_scope: GitHub source snapshot available by 2023, nominal Forebears 2014 estimated ranking
sources.coverage: 1001 observed rows; original initial 500 values preserved byte-for-byte and in original order.
sources.limitations: Unofficial mirror; licence not published, redistribution rights to be reviewed before production. Source ends at approximately rank 1000; other ethnonymic or pan-African lists were not treated as national residence evidence.

sources.geographical_scope: Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa), National Assembly
sources.temporal_scope: Historical legislature data, repository snapshot; not a population census
sources.limitations: Names are representative records of elected politicians, not population distributions; first token inferred as surname only for uppercase surname-first rows; manual onomastic verification outstanding

sources.dataset: République démocratique du Congo, CENI — Liste provisoire des élus à la députation nationale, 2023
sources.geographical_scope: Democratic Republic of the Congo; multiple provinces and constituencies, not Congo-Brazzaville
sources.temporal_scope: National legislative elections 2023, provisional results published 2024
sources.coverage: 143 first NOM tokens newly retained from manually reviewed country-specific CENI table cells
sources.limitations: Name order follows the CENI column NOM, POST-NOM ET PRENOM; ambiguous known given-name/particles omitted. Preliminary elected-member list is not representative of population. PDF mirrored by Radio Okapi; reuse permissions not established
